# Input corpus for the shared canonicalization fixtures.
# Add a line here, run `go run ./cmd/genfixtures`, review the diff in
# testdata/normalize.json, then run both test suites.
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. Leading/trailing
# whitespace is part of the input, so quote-free lines are used as-is.

# basics
HTTP://Evil.COM:8080/a/./b/../c?x=1#frag
https://evil.com
https://evil.com/
evil.com/x
http://EVIL.com/UPPER
http://evil.com:443/x
http://evil.com:80/x
https://user:pw@evil.com./login.php?
http://user@evil.com/x
http://evil.com/#frag
http://evil.com/?
   http://evil.com/x

# path cleaning
https://evil.com//x//y/
http://evil.com/./././
http://evil.com/a/../../b
http://evil.com/%2e%2e/a
http://evil.com/..%2f..%2fetc/passwd
http://EVIL.COM./A//B/../C/./?Q=%41%2f%3f

# percent-encoding
https://evil.com/a%2520b
http://evil.com/a%2520%2525b
http://evil.com/a%3Fb
http://evil.com/a b
http://evil.com/%%%
http://evil.com/%7euser/
http://evil.com/x?y=%2520
http://evil.co.uk/path%20with%20space/?a=b%26c
http://evil.com/%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87
https://xn--bcher-kva.example/%c3%bc/x

# query
http://evil.com/a?b=1?2
http://evil.com/a/b/c/d/e/f?x=1&y=2
http://tricky.com/a?b=c#d?e

# host forms
https://xn--bcher-kva.example/x
http://a..b.com/x
http://sub_domain.evil.com/x
http://ex-ample.com/x
http://xn--fsq.com/x
http://a.b.c/1/2.html?param=1/2
http://a.b.c.d.e/p1/p2/p3/p4/p5/p6
http://a.b.c.d.e.f.g.h.i.evil.com/x
https://a.b.evil.com/x/y/z/w/login.php?t=1

# rejected
https://1.2.3.4/x
https://[2001:db8::1]/x
http://0x7f000001/
http://127.1/x
ftp://evil.com/x
http://localhost/x
javascript:alert(1)

# misc
http://evil.com/x\y
http://evil.com/a\b\c
http://evil.com/a;b,c=d
http://evil.com/!$&'()*+,;=:@/x
